hero.title: Letters I write by hand, for one person each.
hero.lede: I write in a notebook and photograph the pages. A model reads my handwriting. I fix what it got wrong, mark what matters and send one link.

demo.label: A demonstration note from Anna

photo.title: Write and photograph
photo.body: Several pages, by hand. A phone photo is enough, one for each sheet.

scan.title: A model reads it
scan.body: A vision model turns the handwriting into text. I check the words against the original photograph.

pen.title: Mark what to read first
pen.body: Fix the transcription, then highlight what matters in three kinds: important, note and question.

send.title: Publish, then know
send.body: Send the link. I can see if it was opened and answered with a reaction, without storing anyone’s IP.

syntax.title: Markdown in, marked text out.
syntax.note: The marks live in the markdown, so fixing a comma can't move them away from the words. Every kind has a color and its own underline, so the difference survives in black and white too.

package.body: The reusable half: a remark plugin, a sanitize schema, a stylesheet and a React component. For journals, sketchbooks, class notes or letters. It doesn't choose your tags for you, on purpose.

privacy.title: What I count, and what I don’t.
privacy.opened: Opened, reacted to, where it came from
privacy.never: No IPs, public accounts or letter previews
privacy.body: The letter stays out of search engines and link-preview images. There is no public list to browse.

run.title: Clone it. It’s yours.

db.title: Database
db.body: A Postgres database for letters, opens and reactions

photos.title: Photo storage
photos.body: A private Vercel Blob store for the pages

auth.title: Auth
auth.body: Clerk keys and an explicit author allowlist

run.note: Before transcribing, restrict model routing to providers that don't train on your data. Setup and environment variables are in the <readme>README</readme>.
run.personal: There is no sign up here. This one is mine. The code is free to clone.

notFound.title: This page is blank.
notFound.body: Either the link is wrong, or the letter it pointed to isn’t being shared anymore. Every letter here is for one person, so there’s no list to look through. If one was sent to you, the link you got is the only way in.

error.title: The ink smudged.
error.body: This is the site failing, not the letter. Nothing changed and nothing was lost. Try opening the same link again.
